digest.component_or_area: CI workflow - pytest test routing and selection
propositions: Nineteen inventory-pinned repository-policy assertions that inspect only immutable repository text and AST are redundantly executed across all four default-suite matrix cells (Ubuntu 3.11/3.12/3.13 and macOS 3.13).

The shared workflow applies an identical default marker selector to all four matrix cells, causing OS/Python-invariant static policy tests to run on macOS despite their results being platform-independent.

Repository-policy nodes must be marked with a strict repo_policy pytest marker at function level and collected only in the Ubuntu 3.13 default suite, with not repo_policy appended to the other three default selections.

All unmarked behavior in the seven mixed modules must retain its original cross-platform default selection; substring or whole-file routing is rejected because runtime and subprocess contracts must expose platform-specific defects.
The fix must not add new CI jobs, runners, checkout sessions, or pytest sessions; it reuses the existing Ubuntu 3.13 default-suite process.

The exact 19-node inventory collection, marked/non-marked partitioning, four-cell matrix integrity, two pytest sessions, and unchanged integration routing are verified by tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py.
